verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev keeps environments separate: code versions are locked per environment and API keys are scoped per environment. The CLI runs tasks locally, and a community user praises Dev mode for testing and iterating. The evidence never explicitly describes a sandbox, staging or preview environment isolated from production data, so production isolation is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit docs on dev/staging environments isolated from production data, docs on how environment-scoped data and secrets are kept apart, and hands-on corroboration of safe non-production testing.
